---
title: "Parameter Estimates (Variance Scale)"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(here)
library(DT)

res <- readRDS(here("results", "model_fits.rds"))

state_sts  <- res$state_sts
state_bfgs <- res$state_bfgs
state_kem  <- res$state_kem

samp_sd_vec <- dget(here("data", "sampling_error.txt"))

states_abbr <- c("AL","AK","AZ","AR","CA","CO","CT","DE","FL","GA",
                 "HI","ID","IL","IN","IA","KS","KY","LA","ME","MD",
                 "MA","MI","MN","MS","MO","MT","NE","NV","NH","NJ",
                 "NM","NY","NC","ND","OH","OK","OR","PA","RI","SC",
                 "SD","TN","TX","UT","VT","VA","WA","WV","WI","WY")
full_names <- tolower(state.name[match(states_abbr, state.abb)])

# Named vector: full lowercase name -> sampling SD
samp_sd <- setNames(samp_sd_vec[states_abbr], full_names)
```

## StructTS

```{r}
#| label: structts-table
state_sts_table <- as.data.frame(t(state_sts))
state_sts_table$sampling_var <- samp_sd[rownames(state_sts_table)]^2
state_sts_table$shock_var <- state_sts_table[, 3] - state_sts_table$sampling_var
state_sts_table$shock_var[state_sts_table$shock_var < 0] <- NA
colnames(state_sts_table) <- c("drift", "process_var", "observation_var",
                                "sampling_var", "shock_var")
DT::datatable(round(state_sts_table, 6))
```
